name: 纸艺立体定格
line: 卡纸剪刻折叠的纸雕灯箱，一层层前后排开，逆光透亮，安静又梦幻
line_en: Cut, scored and folded card in layered lightbox scenes, backlit and glowing, quiet and dreamy

best.subject: Fairy tales and bedtime stories: a journey across a night sea, a forest or a starry sky; a small character passes through layer after layer of set and meets something much bigger (a whale, the moon, a great tree)
best.palette: Layered cool tones of one family: deep blue, indigo, teal, paler far and deeper near; focal points in cream white and warm yellow (moon, sail, lamp)
best.light: Backlight: moonlight or a lamp from behind, every paper edge glowing, clear shadows between layers, like a paper-cut lightbox
best.camera: Front-on at eye level to show the layers, paper layers parallel to the picture plane; pan within the shot for parallax, never orbit the character

good_for: A small character in frame with something huge
bad_for: Scenes that need to orbit the character or see it from behind
Stories needing lots of soft materials (cloth, fur, water) that deform delicately

music.desc: Night lightbox: soft handbell-like chimes carry the melody, glass-harp broken chords underneath, long cello notes hold the bass, an ocarina answers now and then like a sea breeze; Nepalese hand bells tap the beat lightly. Hits: glass-harp gliss, timpani with suspended cymbal, chime arpeggio

voice.tone: Gentle bedtime story, like turning the pages of a pop-up book at the bedside; short sentences, plenty of pause between them

transitions.name: Paper layer slide
transitions.how: A full-screen foreground paper layer sweeps from the left of the frame to the right (swap it for something this scene has: big waves at sea, leaf piles or grass in a forest, a row of rooftops in a town); the cut hides in the drawings it fully covers (before + after drawings, fully covered for about half, cut in the middle). Asset: generate one transparent paper layer with the layer type, with [set_layers] saying "spans the frame, height at least half the width, the lower three quarters solid with no gaps" (it must be tall enough to cover height × frame height; too flat and it blurs when scaled up; pass the same scene's bg as reference), save as src/layer_big.png; the template's load() reads it and slants both ends. In SHOTS write tr='layer_slide' on the shot after the cut, with one whoosh

transitions.name: Paper layers pop up
transitions.how: Not a transition between shots; no tr=. In the opening of a new scene the set layers stand up one by one, hinged on their bottom edge (like a pop-up book opening). In the opening shot's layers in SHOTS, set each layer's sy as a function of the in-shot drawing index k (from 0): pop = lambda q: (lambda k: min(1.0, max(0.15, 1.1 * kit.ease_out((k - q) / 8)))), sy=pop(0), next layer sy=pop(3) (each layer 3 drawings later, standing fully over 8 drawings from drawing q); drawing 0 already shows the layers at 15%, never a black frame

transitions.name: Glow dissolve
transitions.how: Scene change at a quiet moment: for 8 drawings before the cut the whole frame brightens by 30% (lift, like a lightbox switching on), then dissolve over 8 drawings into the next scene; no bloom. In SHOTS write tr='glow_mix' on the shot after the cut
